item.title: How Often Should You Water Balcony Plants? A Season-by-Season Guide
item.description: How Often Should You Water Balcony Plants? A Season-by-Season Guide The honest answer: it depends. A tomato plant in a black pot on a south-facing balcony in July needs water twice daily. The same plant in a white pot on a north-facing balcony in October needs water twice weekly. This guide shows you how to read the variables and develop a watering rhythm that matches your specific balcony conditions. Fast Starting Schedule Use this as a starting point, then adjust after checking actual soil moisture.
